description_for_human: All-in-one security agent — monitor, detect, scan, and protect servers in real time.
description_for_model: ThreatCrush is a Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) platform combining a server agent/daemon, CLI, desktop app, and hosted dashboard. It exposes a public module marketplace API and a public blog feed. Use this manifest to discover the OpenAPI spec at /openapi.yaml for programmatic access to module listings and blog RSS.
